overview: The Medford City Council approved funding and an ordinance amendment for a newly negotiated police contract, addressed resident complaints regarding city snow removal operations, and requested funding for upgraded municipal broadcasting equipment.

items.title: Proposed Executive Session on Personnel Issue
items.summary: The Council voted to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting regarding a former city employee after City Solicitor Mark Rumley advised that Open Meeting Law requires advance notice before discussing a specific individual in executive session.

items.title: Police Patrolmen's Association Contract and Funding
items.summary: The Council approved the first reading of an ordinance amending Chapter 66 compensation plans for police patrol officers and authorized $750,000 in account transfers to cover retroactive pay and FY18 wage increases.

items.title: Public Comment and Resolutions on Snow Removal
items.summary: Following resident testimony regarding plow speed and driveway blockages, the Council approved an amended resolution directing DPW to review complaints, examine contractor standards, establish a 24-hour storm hotline, and clear snow from school routes and designated intersections.

items.title: Medford Square Tree Lighting
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting that tree lights remain lit in Medford Square for public safety and asked for an update regarding permanent street lighting upgrades.

items.title: Traffic Engineer Hiring Update
items.summary: The Council approved a request for a written status update and job posting locations for the vacant traffic engineer position.

items.title: Police Chief Remarks
items.summary: Police Chief Leo Sacco thanked the Council and administration for approving the police patrolmen's contract and funding.

items.title: Special Permit Reviews
items.summary: The Council accepted review reports for extended hours permits at Wegmans and Annie's Pizzeria, and tabled a review for an illuminated sign at the Evangelical Haitian Church.

items.title: Motions, Condolences, and Broadcasting Equipment Request
items.summary: The Council approved resolutions congratulating Firefighters Local 1032 officers, requesting fire equipment updates and National Grid tree removal, extending Christmas tree collection, expressing condolences, and requesting mayor funding for upgraded community TV broadcasting equipment.
